name: video
description: Video editing, YouTube channels, short-form social video, and creator/influencer content work
_comment_keywords: Sent to Upwork as separate searches. Each one costs one request per page per cycle, so add with intent. Ordered roughly by how central they are to the niche.
_comment_match_terms: A job is kept when any of these appears in its title or skills. Broad searches like 'influencer' and 'social media video' return marketing roles with no video work, and this is what filters them out.
_comment_exclude_terms: Checked against the TITLE only. Skills are not checked, because a genuine video job can carry an unrelated skill tag like 'Lead Generation' and would be wrongly dropped.
